The '''Alba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alba-16]].
